title: 観察法
subtitle: Observational Method
keywords: Natural Observation / Experimental Observation 2.Time-sampling 3.Event-sampling 4.Hypothesis-generating Research 5.Regional Collaboration
educationalGoal: The observational method is the most basic scientific research method, which involves looking closely at phenomena, especially human behavior in the case of psychology. The observational method is also used in hypothesis-testing research as well as in exploratory hypothesis-generating research. In this course, students will learn the basic concepts of the observation method, how to plan and conduct observations, and how to analyze the data, with practical exercises.
advice: In this class, the following topics will be studied with practical exercises. 1. Basic characteristics of observation methods 2. Types of observation methods 3. How to perform observation methods 4. Basic analysis methods in observation methods 5. Appropriate interpretation of observation data In the practical training, teams of several students will be formed to experience the flow of each type of observation method, from setting the research objectives, planning and conducting observations (data collection), to analysis and interpretation. Since research using observation methods often focuses on the casual behaviors that people take in their daily lives, we recommend that participants in this class pay attention to people's daily behaviors and their characteristics. The lecture content and schedule are subject to change slightly.
books: Reference books are introduced in the class.
requiredKnowledge: Review the basics of observation methods learned in "Research Methods in Psychology". In addition, it will be helpful to review the knowledge of other research methods learned in previous classes and the methods used to obtain various findings in psychology, in order to understand the characteristics and implementation of the observation method.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and to explain the basic features of the observation method.
Ability to understand and to perform the characteristics and implementation of natural observation.
Ability to understand and to perform the characteristics and implementation of experimental observation.
Ability to understand and to perform analysis of observation data based on the time-sampling method.
Ability to understand and to perform analysis of observation data based on the event-sampling method.
Ability to interpret the results of obsabational data analysis appropriately, and to create new hypothesis.

achievementLevels.ideal: Ability to Understand and explain the basic concepts of the observation method. Ability to plan a research project using appropriate observation methods according to the style of research. Ability to perform observations and collect data appropriately for the purpose. Ability to analyze observational data appropriately and interpret them appropriately according to the purpose.
achievementLevels.standard: Ability to Understand and explain the basic concepts of the observation method. Ability to plan and execute appropriate data collection using observational methods. Ability to appropriately analyze and interpret data obtained through observation.
